mechanism: Foscarnet can cause significant electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment, which increases everolimus toxicity and reduces clearance; both drugs have immunosuppressive effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate), and everolimus levels closely; adjust everolimus dosing based on renal function and clinical response; consider alternative antivirals if possible.
